name: Wherryman Jem

intro.text: Afternoon, bor. My granddad skippered wherries down this river, my dad cut reed on that marsh, and I've beaten every Keeper who ever came through St Benet's for a picnic.
Folk call me the Broadsman. I'll warn you now: I don't do it by halves. Full crew, full sail. Ready?

win: Well I'll be blowed. Proper beat, I am, and fair. You're welcome on my river any day.
after: The Broads was dug by hand, bor. Every lake you see was somebody's spade, one turf at a time. Never let anyone tell you small work don't add up.
